global_flags.name: --bench-dir
global_flags.help: Bench to act on (default: remembered, or auto-detected).

global_flags.name: --site
global_flags.help: Site name (default: remembered, or from the bench).

commands.name: service
commands.summary: Install or refresh only the background service (phase 02).

flags.name: --dry-run
flags.help: Print the plan and its token, change nothing.

env.name: BENCHBAR_SUDO
env.help: Linux only: env makes the sudo steps use BENCHBAR_SUDO_PASSWORD, no terminal needed (a wrong one fails at once with error_id sudo_password_wrong, before any change).

env.name: BENCHBAR_SUDO_PASSWORD
env.help: The sudo password, with BENCHBAR_SUDO=env. Read once at startup and removed from the environment; never in argv, the log or a child.

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: Read only health report. Exit 1 when something FAILs.

flags.name: --fix-hints
flags.help: Only the fix commands, one per line.

flags.name: --quick
flags.help: Skip the slow checks and say which.

flags.name: --ack
flags.help: Silence one named WARN for this bench until its message changes.

flags.name: --prerequisites
flags.help: What this machine needs before an install, no bench needed.

flags.name: --fetch
flags.help: git fetch the branches of the apps your focus apps need first.

commands.name: status
commands.summary: State, pid, stop reason, site ping.

flags.name: --ping
flags.help: Ask every site, not only the default one.

env.name: BENCHBAR_LOAD_ALL
env.help: Debugging switch: 1 loads every library, as before the lean start (the output is the same; use it to see whether a problem comes from the lean load).

commands.name: up
commands.summary: Start the bench in the background.

flags.name: --services-only
flags.help: Start only the bench's Redis (for a restore or a migrate); down stops it.

commands.name: down
commands.summary: Stop the bench and keep it stopped across reboots.

commands.name: fg
commands.summary: Stop the service and run honcho in the foreground.

commands.name: watch
commands.summary: Run bench watch for asset rebuilds.

commands.name: autostart
commands.summary: Whether the bench may come back after login.

commands.name: lock check
commands.summary: Compare the bench with benchbar.toml. Exit 1 on any difference.

commands.name: lock apply
commands.summary: Clone missing apps, switch branches, fast forward to pinned commits.
